summary.summary: PROVED block 143's (A') at tan K0 = (5/6, 18/5) on Z^2 and (5/6, 18/5, 1/2) on Z^3 by an algebraic certificate independent of T6's resultants and interval boxes: in circle variables (cos 2k1, sin 2k1) with signed energies e1, e2 (all four band pairs at once) and z e1 e2 = 1 off the cones, the system 'stationary and det Hess = 0' has Groebner basis [1], so no degenerate stationary point exists even over C; a K0 = 0 control is not [1]; cones are strict conical extrema (tilt^2 < 1).

review: Self-review (claude-opus-5-5). The certificate is an ideal membership 1 in I: a Groebner basis equal to [1]. It is exact over Q and covers all four band pairs at once through signed energies; circle variables leave no chart gaps, and z e1 e2 = 1 excludes the cones. The gradient and Hessian formulas are cross-checked against direct differentiation (40-digit control), and the logic from basis [1] to nondegeneracy is written out. Controls: without the determinant the basis is not [1], and at K0 = 0, where a flat band is degenerate, the basis is not [1]. The cone tilts are recomputed exactly. The method differs from T6's resultants and intervals and from a2's Krawczyk boxes. T6's internal counts are not rechecked. Related: my #9251 uses T6 (disclosed).
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 2: Certify that the free pair's band functions have only nondegenerate stationary points at one total wave vector. LANDED FIRST: origin/main is the science authority; read each named note as landed (git show origin/main:docs/<note>) before any PR branch, and where a PR's wording differs from the landed text, the landed text controls. Blocks 137, 140 and 143 are OPEN hand-off PRs (#9197, #9203, #9229): read them on their branches (gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName; git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>). They are the supervisor's own derivations (Claude), NOT refereed by another family; nothing in them is adopted. SETTING: block 143 (PR #9229) shows, for two records of block 54's walk, that a kept total energy current makes the pair transparent (T3), and that a transparent finite-rank change of the free pair has perturbation determinant identically one (T5), so nothing local keeps the books under one record per site. T5 rests on one named assumption (A'): at some total wave vector K0 the four band functions E(q) = s1 eps(K0/2 + q) + s2 eps(K0/2 - q) (eps = (sum_a sin^2 k_a)^(1/2), s1, s2 = +-1) have only nondegenerate stationary points on the torus, away from the cone points where eps vanishes; by persistence of nondegenerate stationary points this then holds near K0, which suffices. A floating-point search found, at K0 = (0.7, 1.3) on Z^2, 16, 8, 8 and 16 stationary points for the four band pairs with smallest |det Hess| about 0.27, and at K0 = (0.7, 1.3, 0.45) on Z^3, 64, 48, 48 and 64 with smallest about 0.29; that search is not a proof. TASK: certify (A') exactly at one K0 in the plane and, if you can, in space, choosing K0 with rational half-angle tangents: for example, write the stationary-point equations s1 grad eps(k1) = s2 grad eps(k2), k2 = K0 - k1, as polynomial equations in half-angle tangents (squaring where needed and keeping track of the spurious sign branches), eliminate by resultants, count real roots with Sturm sequences, and show that no root makes the Hessian determinant vanish (a gcd or resultant test); or give a rational interval-arithmetic certificate (Krawczyk test at each root plus exclusion boxes elsewhere) in exact arithmetic. Also check the cone points (eps = 0), where the band functions are not smooth, for stationary behaviour. HIT: (A') certified at one K0 in the plane (and in space), with exact checks. UPDATE (amendment q): block 143's second follow-up commit (PR #9229, T6) now claims an exact proof at tan K0 = (5/6, 18/5) on Z^2 and (5/6, 18/5, 1/2) on Z^3 (resultants of degree 16 and 40 in t1 = tan k1_1, exact real-root isolation, rational interval arithmetic; 4 and 2, and 8 and 6, nondegenerate stationary points per half-period cell (a quarter of the torus in the plane, an eighth in space; corrected in amendment s); cone tilts 139761000/606502321 and 2653455542/8714332815). Check that proof independently, line by line (a different elimination order, a different chart or a different K0 are welcome), or find an error in it; a confirmed or refuted T6 is the HIT. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/nondegenerate-stationary-points-of-the-pair-bands-at-one-wave-vector/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes AS LANDED ON MAIN (git show origin/main:<note>); use a PR branch (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName,state) only for a note that is not on main; any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/nondegenerate-stationary-points-of-the-pair-bands-at-one-wave-vector/<name>/check.py"
